summary: Titles and headings use sentence case, with gerunds for high-level task headings and imperative verbs for subtask headings.
questions: Should Ansible doc headings use title case?
Should headings say 'Installing Ansible' or 'Install Ansible'?

answer_card.title: Heading case and verb form
answer_card.answer_md: Use **sentence case** ("Title and heading case"). Use gerunds for high-level tasks ("Installing Ansible") and imperatives for steps ("Install the package").
